openosint-openosint-exposure.description: Grade a domain's external exposure A-F with OpenOSINT (email authentication, TLS, domain registration, security headers). Use when the user asks for an exposure check, security posture, email-spoofing or DMARC/SPF check, or "how exposed is this domain". No API key needed.

openosint-openosint-osint.description: Passive open-source reconnaissance and external exposure checks for a domain, IP address or organization, using OpenOSINT (DNS, RDAP, WHOIS, email authentication, TLS, security headers, news mentions, search dorks). Use when the user asks to investigate, profile, recon or "look up" a domain, IP or company, or to check what a domain exposes to the internet. No API keys needed for the default flow.
